input_text: - The HAUSER signal must be valid during the address phase of a transfer.
label_note: Address-phase validity obligation; the 'during the address phase' clause carries no signal-value predicate, so the antecedent is empty (faithful to the representable content). Manager drives HAUSER (table Source). Expected TP.

input_text: - The HWUSER signal must be valid during the data phase of a write transfer.
label_note: Data-phase validity obligation, no signal-value antecedent. Manager drives HWUSER. Expected TP.

input_text: - The HRUSER signal must be valid during the data phase of a read transfer when HREADY signal is HIGH, unless HRESP signal is ERROR.
label_note: The timing condition is 'when HREADY signal is HIGH' (antecedent HREADY=HIGH). 'unless HRESP signal is ERROR' is an EXCEPTION, not the antecedent — the extractor must not use HRESP=ERROR as the condition. Subordinate drives HRUSER.

input_text: - The HBUSER signal must be valid during the data phase of a read or write transfer when HREADY signal is HIGH, unless HRESP signal is ERROR.
label_note: Antecedent is HREADY=HIGH ('when HREADY signal is HIGH'); 'unless HRESP signal is ERROR' is an exception, not the condition. Subordinate drives HBUSER.
